verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents a broad API surface beyond basic data access. It covers admin functions such as access-control policies and company-wide number blocking, compliance actions like contact anonymization and recording/AI-data removal, and live call control including adding participants and assigning contact-center operators. It also offers recording downloads, webhooks, websocket event subscriptions, OAuth and a Python client. However, nothing states or demonstrates that every UI capability is exposed through the API, and many UI features have no evidenced API equivalent, such as Listen In/Barge In/Take Over coaching, AI CSAT, meetings and AI agent configuration. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API coverage for the coaching, meetings and AI agent/CSAT features, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent corroboration of coverage depth.
